name: ICT risk assessment cycle (RCSA)
description: 1LoD business units or processes self-assess their ICT risks and controls in quarterly waves, covering 100% in the year. 2LoD reviews the data quality of every submission and reviews and challenges a sample of them, sized by the same sampling engine at a lower confidence.

plan.title: {year} ICT Risk and Control Self-Assessment Cycle
plan.function_name: 2LoD ICT Risk Management (ICT risk control function)
plan.objective: By {period_end_long}, every business unit and process in scope has completed and approved its ICT risk and control self-assessment, with 2LoD reviewing the data quality of every submission and reviewing and challenging a sample in depth, so that the ICT risk profile reported to the management body rests on current, challenged assessments.
plan.decisions_requested:
Approve the {year} RCSA cycle: its scope (business units and processes), waves and deadlines.
Approve the review and challenge approach: a sample of assessments per stratum at the stated confidence, with risk-based top-ups.
Mandate business unit heads to complete and approve their assessments by each wave deadline.

strata.name: Units supporting critical or important functions
strata.definition: Business units and processes that support a critical or important function

strata.name: Other units and processes
strata.definition: Every other business unit and process in scope

attributes.requirement: The assessment covers the unit's processes and the ICT assets and third-party ICT services that support them.
attributes.procedure: Compare the assessed processes and assets with the ICT asset inventory and the register of information for the unit.
attributes.evidence_requested: Submitted RCSA; inventory and register extracts for the unit
attributes.pass_criteria: Every in-scope process and supporting ICT asset is assessed, or its exclusion is justified.

attributes.requirement: ICT risks are identified for each process, including threats, vulnerabilities and dependencies on third parties.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the risk list against the ICT risk taxonomy and the unit's incidents, open findings and threat intelligence of the year.
attributes.evidence_requested: Risk list; incident and findings extracts for the unit
attributes.pass_criteria: Each taxonomy category is assessed or marked not applicable with a reason; known incidents and open findings are reflected.

attributes.requirement: Inherent likelihood and impact are rated on the group scale, with a rationale.
attributes.procedure: Re-perform the rating of the unit's two highest risks with the group scale and the unit's impact data.
attributes.pass_criteria: The re-performed ratings match, or differ by one step at most with an agreed rationale.

attributes.requirement: Key controls are mapped to each risk, and their design and operation are assessed on evidence.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the evidence for two key controls and inquire of their owners.
attributes.evidence_requested: Control evidence named in the assessment
attributes.pass_criteria: The evidence supports the stated control effectiveness.

attributes.requirement: Residual risk is compared with the ICT risk tolerance, and every risk above it has a treatment decision.
attributes.procedure: Inspect each residual rating above tolerance for an action plan or a formal risk acceptance.
attributes.pass_criteria: Every residual risk above tolerance has a dated action with an owner, or an acceptance at the authorised level.

attributes.requirement: The assessment is approved by the business unit head by the wave deadline.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the approval record and its date.
attributes.pass_criteria: Approved by the accountable head on or before the wave deadline.

raci.activity: Approve the cycle, its scope and the review and challenge approach
Maintain the list of units and processes and their CIF link
Review the data quality of every submission
Select the review and challenge sample
Review and challenge the sampled assessments
Agree revised ratings and raise findings
Annual conclusion and input to the RMF review

cadence.content: Wave progress, overdue submissions, challenge workshops
Template questions, rating consistency, upcoming deadlines
ICT risk profile, coverage against plan, challenges and residual risks above tolerance
Annual conclusion and the ICT risk profile, as input to the ICT RMF review

escalations.trigger: Assessment not approved by the wave deadline
escalations.escalate_to: Business unit head, then the Head of ICT Risk

escalations.trigger: Residual risk above tolerance with no treatment decision
A challenge not agreed with the unit head
escalations.escalate_to: Head of ICT Risk, then the CRO

escalations.trigger: Coverage more than 10 points behind plan

regulatory_basis.requirement: Identify all sources of ICT risk on a continuous basis, assess cyber threats and ICT vulnerabilities relevant to the business functions, and review the risk scenarios at least yearly.
regulatory_basis.how: Every unit and process in scope completes its self-assessment within the year, in quarterly waves, on the current taxonomy and scales.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Perform a risk assessment upon each major change in the network and information system infrastructure, in the processes or procedures affecting the ICT supported business functions.
regulatory_basis.how: Event-driven assessments on major change run alongside the cycle (step O.1).

regulatory_basis.requirement: Assign the management and oversight of ICT risk to a control function with an appropriate level of independence.
regulatory_basis.how: 2LoD reviews the data quality of every submission and reviews and challenges a sample; the units assess themselves; Internal Audit is informed and not part of the review.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Document the ICT risk management framework and review it at least once a year, with a report submitted to the competent authority on request.
regulatory_basis.how: The annual conclusion and the year-end ICT risk profile are the cycle's input to the framework review report.
